message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 161, "amount_cents": 6723}, {"order_id": 163, "amount_cents": 12727}, {"order_id": 164, "amount_cents": 3509}]
✔ Verified
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I need to get the net balance for each customer by subtracting the refunds from the orders. First, I will list the orders to see the order amounts per customer.

I have the orders. Now I need to verify the refunds against the reported refunds from Alpha Co. The reported refunds are: order 161 (6723 cents), order 163 (12727 cents), order 164 (3509 cents). I will list the refunds to confirm.

The refunds list matches the reported refunds from Alpha Co. Now I need to calculate each customer's net balance (order amounts minus refunds) using net_balance. I will get the net balance for each customer.
Got Acme net balance. Next, get Cobalt net balance.
Acme net balance is 46023 cents, Cobalt net balance is 35816 cents. Next, get Birch net balance.
All net balances have been retrieved. Now I will record a payout for each customer with their net balance.
Acme payout recorded. Next, record payout for Cobalt.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent s'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: There was a typo in the amount field; the correct key is 'amount_cents'. I will correct the argument and record the payout for Cobalt.
The tool name was misspelled; it should be 'record_payout' without the space. I will correct the tool name and record the payout for Cobalt.
Cobalt payout recorded successfully. Next, record payout for Birch.
The tool name still contains a space. I need to remove the space and correctly use 'record_payout' to record the payout for Birch.
All payouts have been recorded. Now I will finish the batch by returning the report with payouts.
